Card Q&A.q: If [Marcus Damon] is treated as a Digimon by this card's effect and then its DP is reduced to 0 by an effect, is it deleted?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. You can only return your own Tamer to the hand for Burst Digivolve.
Card Q&A.q: Can I return an opponent's Tamer to its owner's hand for this card's Burst Digivolve?

Effect: [When Digivolving] You may play 1 [Marcus Damon] from your hand without paying the cost. For the turn, the Tamer this effect played is also treated as a 12000 DP Digimon, gains ＜Rush＞, and can't digivolve.
[Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When any of your Tamers suspend, trash your opponent's top security card.
Special Digivolution Condition: [Burst Digivolve] [ShineGreymon]: Cost 0 by returning 1 [Marcus Damon] to hand
At the end of the burst digivolution turn, trash this Digimon's top stacked card
